name: extend_video_flow
description: One call: more seconds of coherent motion appended to a prior clip — the prior plays first, fresh motion and sound follow, joined into one film. WHAT it produces: the extended film artifact (prior + new seconds, one mp4). HOW it runs: ONE card= stage on h3-timeline whose extend arm anchors on the prior clip's LAST FRAME (taken in-graph, negative batch index), renders the new window at full denoise under an all-white mask, and joins prior + new through the film tail's file law (both parts save at SaveVideo prefixes, MeliteConcatVideos decodes them back after every save); the {flow:} door submits one merged run (validate then start), and runs start at the user's Run press — refusals are door-level, zero GPU until then. The two body keys are the initials: source_clip — a stageable video (mp4/webm/mkv/mov/m4v/avi; a /melite-media/runs/ artifact URL from an earlier run lands) and extend_prompt — MOTION and SOUND picking up where the clip ends. The numeric knobs do NOT ride the body (numbers never ride initials): extend_seconds (default 2.33, on the engine grid — frames become seconds at the schema fps default: 2.33 = 56f, 3.75 = 90f, 5.17 = 124f, 15.08 = 362f the largest single window; beyond it the door composes N uniform windows under the 39f overlap, exact delivery or a loud refusal; off-grid refuses at the compose door) and seed (default 0) state through params: {extend: [{extend_seconds: …, seed: …}]} — the whole-bag override, raw numbers.

source_clip.description: Required. The prior clip — a stageable video path (a /melite-media/runs/<run_id>/<file>.mp4 artifact URL from an earlier run lands; a browser-local blob/data URL refuses — upload first).

extend_prompt.description: Required. The continuation text — MOTION and SOUND for the appended seconds, picking up exactly where the clip ends.
